question: The book A suitable Boy was authored by _______________ in 1993.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Seth**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Seth** is the author of the book **"A Suitable Boy"**.
 
• The book was published in the year **1993**.
 
• "A Suitable Boy" is one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume in the English language.
 
• The story is set in post-independence, post-partition India and follows the lives of four families over a period of 18 months.
 
• It explores various social and political issues in India during that period, including the complexities of arranged marriages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Seth** is an Indian novelist and poet, born on June 20, 1952.
 
• He has received several awards for his literary works, including the Padma Shri, one of India's highest civilian awards.
 
• Other notable works by Vikram Seth include **"The Golden Gate"** and **"An Equal Music"**.
 
• "A Suitable Boy" was adapted into a television miniseries by the BBC in 2020.
 
• Seth's writing is known for its rich character development and intricate portrayal of Indian society.
